description: This file provides tools for redirecting std::cout and std::cerr to Python streams using pybind11, including classes for stream buffer management and context managers for redirecting output.

classes.name: pythonbuf
classes.description: A custom stream buffer that writes to Python objects instead of C++ streams.

classes.name: scoped_ostream_redirect
classes.description: A move-only guard class that redirects an ostream to a Python stream within a scope.

classes.name: scoped_estream_redirect
classes.description: A specialized redirect class for std::cerr, inheriting from scoped_ostream_redirect.

classes.name: OstreamRedirect
classes.description: A class managing redirection of stdout and stderr as a context manager.

methods.name: add_ostream_redirect
methods.description: Adds a Python context manager for redirecting stdout/stderr to a C++ ostream.
